findings.text: the record's definition of the headline figure was reworded from 'the total worker-seconds inside the window' to 'inside the ledger', while concurrency() at scripts/lane_window_census.py:146 divides the area clipped to the window by the window's seconds; the sentence's own next clause still says 'divided by the window's seconds', so the record states a definition the script does not implement.

counts['run_store'] is asserted equal to str(db), the same argument the test passed to load_runs at :288, and figure['as_of'] is asserted equal to ended.isoformat() at :249 after being passed in at :245; both sides of each assertion move with the input, so neither can fail on a regression, unlike the set and count assertions beside them.

the claim that every one of the 148 spans overlapping the window is also a hot row, so the archive contributes no span to either window, is recorded in prose only: the committed census JSON reports runs_in_archive and worker_spans but no archived-span contribution, so this zero cannot be re-derived from the artifacts.
